create_coefficient_mapping: create a CoefficientMapping module to map spherical harmonic coefficients between degree l and order m representations
get_coefficient_indices: get the tensor indices for spherical harmonic coefficients less than or equal to a given degree and order
compute_complex_indices: compute real and imaginary part indices for spherical harmonic coefficients of a specific order m
transform_irreps_to_grid: transform an irreps embedding tensor into a 2D grid representation on the SO3 sphere using SO3_Grid
transform_grid_to_irreps: transform a 2D grid representation on the SO3 sphere back into an irreps embedding tensor
